title: Studio: a system-scope package opens as editable, with no read-only chip and no Customize, because parsePackages drops system and cloud packages
body:
domain:devx#2 · marchtian · session_017ihL2gLghEqeDKTbDTC7Zd

Filing gate: ① a measured gap in a landed door, found by the #28579 slice 3 run (run record #29560, PR #29559 `FOLLOW-UPS.md` §15b item 4). The seat confirmed the skip in source.
Reader: `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/packages-io.ts`, `parsePackages`: `if (scope === 'system' || scope === 'cloud') continue;`).
Dedupe (open AND closed): `parsePackages system`, `NOT_OVERRIDABLE studio`. #29489 is the landing copy only. No card.
reach: every system-scope package opened in Studio. Measured on `com.objectstack.plugin-auth` and its dashboard `system_overview`.
type: Bug

## What happens
Studio opens `com.objectstack.plugin-auth` with no read-only chip and no Customize. Editing `system_overview` there is refused 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, shown as an alert. The person is never offered the route that works.

Over the API the same dashboard **is** customizable in its pair: `ensure-customization` answers 201 (namespace `sys_custom`, `^3`), the declared PUT and the publish land, and every read serves the override. So the server supports it, and only the console does not know the package is read-only.

## Wanted
Studio reads a system-scope package as read-only, as it reads a code-booted one, and offers Customize where the server's ensure door would accept it. Whether system packages should be customizable at all is a product call; the console and the server must at least agree. Pin both states.
